FQ398.question: When did this year's Passover start?
FQ398.answer:
Passover 2026 begins on the evening of **Wednesday, April 1, 2026** [Supported]. Specifically, the holiday starts before sundown on that day [Supported], with the first seder being held after nightfall [Supported]. On the Hebrew calendar, this start date corresponds to the 15th day of the month of Nisan [Supported].

While some sources may list the first full day of the holiday as Thursday, April 2, 2026 [Supported], Jewish holidays traditionally begin at sunset the evening before [Supported]. The festival celebrates freedom and the Exodus from Egypt [Supported] and is traditionally observed as a spring festival [Supported]. The holiday is expected to conclude on either April 8 or April 9, 2026, depending on the tradition followed [Supported].
